messages:
maya: Quick convo: UX needs to display autofallback decisions compactly. Goal: let operators understand mode, trigger, and quota effect at a glance, and drill into sampled requests for confidence checks. tagging @liam @sarah
liam: Proposal: single-line status chip on rollout list + detail page. chip includes mode icon, reason shortcode, and a tiny estimate badge for quota. clicking the chip opens the audit playback.
sarah: +1. Add a toggle for 'sample-only' so we can run dry experiments without changing routing. Sampling view should show examples and a simple delta estimate (tokens/month).
dan: API requirements: include stable enums for mode/reason in the route status endpoint. add header `X-Redwood-Fallback: mode=soft;reason=timeout;id=0x4b2e` so downstream services can log/join traces.
aj: Keep header compact and machine-friendly. Limit to keys mode,reason,id,t=timestamp maybe. 128 bytes max. We'll enforce grammar in docs.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolling canary for `autofallback-ui` started by @liam  logs: https://ci.redwood/example-run/4730
maya: UX deliverables: (a) chip + hover tooltip with top signal, (b) small 'Audit' CTA opening a sampled-request drawer, (c) cooldown indicator if decisions are oscillating. Also show required approvers for policy edits.
liam: For cooldown, show "cooldown: 2m" and a pause button. Implementation detail: cooldown state comes from policy engine via status API.
sarah: For sampling, include a 'preview' mode that returns the same decision headers but doesn't commit changes. We should surface the projected billing delta as a percent and absolute tokens. Keep conservative estimates (use 95th perc).
dan: I'll add `?dry_run=true` to rollout endpoints and ensure we emit `decision_id`. Also will add `sampled=true` in telemetry for previewed events.
aj: Telemetry: add `fallback_reason` enum and `decision_id` to v1 events. Ensure event schema stays flat for Sentry/ELK ingestion. Example event we will document as text in the API docs.
maya: UX copy example: `[Soft ▪ latency] — Quota est: -3.8% (monthly). Audit` — hover shows short signal reasons and top contributing metrics.
sarah: Also provide a 'Why' modal with top 3 signals (p99 latency, error rate, quota saturation) and linked sampled requests. That will help SREs avoid blind flips.
liam: Permission model: policy edits should require rollout-owner + ops approval if rollout is 'protected'. Show approver list on the page and disable commit button until approved.
ops-bot: incident-bot: alert: unusual sampling rate on route `auth-login` at 2025-02-09T09:37Z — currently in sample-only mode.
dan: I'll map the incident to `decision_id=0x4b2e` and fetch sampled payloads.
aj: Tiny API grammar note: header values should always use lowercase enum strings and semicolon separators. We'll publish a code example and an OpenAPI fragment.
maya: Edge-case: rapid oscillation between soft/hard modes. Visual idea: micro-timeline showing last 8 decisions with badges and a 'stabilize' toggle that increases cooldown if enabled.
liam: Good. Action items: liam -> PR for UI chip + hover + pause CTA; dan -> add dry_run & decision_id + header; aj -> API docs + telemetry schema; sarah -> mock for audit drawer; maya -> copy and product signoff. Sync tomorrow 09:30 to review canary metrics.
sarah: One more: include a compact "impact" link to Optimize suggestions (batching/quantization) so operators can get remediation steps from the same view.
maya: Perfect. If anyone wants to test the canary, DM me and I'll add you to the rollout sample group.
